name: unix-driver-cartagena
description: UniX Driver · Cartagena — aplicación Android (Capacitor 7 + HTML/CSS/JS)

scripts.build:web: node tools/sync-env.js && node tools/build-destinos.js && node tools/build-html.js
scripts.build:apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build:apk:win: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.build:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.test: node tools/sync-env.js && node tests/test-v71.mjs && node tests/test-boton.mjs
